summary: The bounded CRSR full review rechecked the current Q2 Form 10-Q and SEC-filed results release and prepared a scenario-complete reassessment against the canonical USD 14.35 mark. The deterministic assessment applier rejected the request because two proposed soft-gap values were not canonical. Per controller policy, the rejected assessment command was not retried or substituted. The security page was restored byte-for-byte to the accepted quick-check version, and final security context confirms its hash still matches assessment_d52252a2530f6940e6cd. A bounded security-row correction was separately rejected because next_review_at did not strictly follow last_research_at, so the earlier applied security-row draft remains explicit failed-operation evidence. No assessment, strategy, signal, order, allocation, execution, cash, portfolio, fill, or performance state changed.
